# Walmart Marketplace Canonical Card Pack — v17 Edge-Covered Ordered

## 0. Issue Register and Curation Notes

```yaml
issue_register:
- issue_id: walmart.v17.semantic_edge_coverage
  status: resolved
  resolution: Cards were normalized to v17 universal semantic profiles; all structured references are materialized as canonical
    edges; embeddings were rewritten as Walmart-specific business prose grounded in the DOCX.
```

## 1. Introduction and Scope Boundary

Reusable Walmart marketplace semantic pack. Runtime/client cards, bank transfer reconciliation, external WFS warehouse operations, ERP/accounting, and statutory filing cards are out of scope.

## 2. Validation Contract

Locked v17 full-spectrum validation applies: structural checks, edge coverage, claim consistency, universal semantic profiles, curation quality, SQL blueprint checks, and zero warnings.

        Walmart net seller payout.

      required_tables:

        \ AS wm_savings,\n  SUM(charged_amount_excluding_tax + gross_commission) AS estimated_net_payout\nFROM zs_observe.walmart_settlement\n\
        WHERE is_active = true\n  AND group_level_id = :group_level_id\nGROUP BY 1, 2\nORDER BY 1"
